name: NetHunt CRM
description_en:
NetHunt CRM organizes contacts, companies and deals around a sales team's communication. Its Gmail integration lets users work with CRM context inside the inbox, while the current product also describes messaging, phone and other connected channels. Records, configurable pipelines and assigned tasks form the core sales model; workflow automation adds event-driven follow-ups and updates on eligible plans.

It is worth evaluating when a team wants email and customer records close together without treating the mailbox as the entire CRM database. Check how the actual channel connects, which fields are shared and which plan enables automation. The following profile uses vendor product and help pages, including import matching and action-metering details. It does not claim to have installed the extension, sent a message or measured sales performance.
description_zh:
NetHunt CRM 围绕销售团队沟通组织联系人、公司和交易。Gmail 集成让用户在收件箱内使用 CRM 背景；当前产品还描述消息、电话等连接渠道。记录、可配置管线及有负责人的任务构成基本销售模型，符合套餐条件时可用工作流执行事件驱动跟进与更新。

团队希望让邮件与客户记录靠近、又不把邮箱当作整个 CRM 数据库时，可以评估 NetHunt。需核对实际渠道如何连接、共享哪些字段，以及哪个套餐开放自动化。本文依据产品和帮助页说明导入匹配及动作计量，没有安装扩展、发送消息或测量销售表现。

core_features.explanation_en: Use customer context, pipelines and assigned follow-up work from the connected Gmail inbox.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在连接的 Gmail 收件箱内使用客户背景、管线和已分配跟进工作。

core_features.name_zh: 可配置销售记录与管线
core_features.explanation_en: Adapt fields, stages and views to a team process while retaining communication context.
core_features.explanation_zh: 调整字段、阶段和视图以适应团队流程，并保留沟通背景。

core_features.explanation_en: Respond to record or activity changes with tasks, messages and updates, subject to plan and action limits.
core_features.explanation_zh: 以任务、消息和更新响应记录或活动变化，受套餐及动作额度限制。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure unique-field matching and warn/block rules rather than assuming every duplicate is merged automatically.
core_features.explanation_zh: 配置唯一字段匹配和警告／阻止规则，而非假定重复项都会自动合并。

en: Review a lead email and update the related opportunity without losing its context.
Assign a follow-up task and update a CRM field after a qualifying change.
zh: 审阅线索邮件并更新相关机会，同时保留背景。
符合条件的变化后分配跟进任务并更新 CRM 字段。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative tasks, not executed sales operations.

Access and setup.en: Managed CRM workspace; the documented Gmail onboarding route installs a Chrome extension, connects Gmail and invites workspace users.
Access and setup.zh: 托管 CRM 工作空间；文档中的 Gmail 入门路径包括安装 Chrome 扩展、连接 Gmail 和邀请工作空间用户。

steps.en: Connect the intended account and define folders, fields, pipeline stages and team access.
steps.zh: 连接目标账户，定义文件夹、字段、管线阶段和团队访问。

steps.en: Use a representative CSV to check the unique matching field, overwrite behavior and duplicate rules.
steps.zh: 用代表性 CSV 核对唯一匹配字段、覆盖行为和重复规则。

steps.en: Test one workflow and inspect successful action consumption against the workspace billing-cycle counter.
steps.zh: 测试一条工作流，并按工作空间账单周期计数器核对成功动作消耗。

items.name: Gmail
items.scope: CRM context in the connected inbox; extension permissions and sync behavior untested.

items.en: Importing updates overwrites existing single-value fields while multivalue fields append new values.
items.zh: 导入更新会覆盖已有单值字段，多值字段则追加新值。

items.en: Automation actions are quota-limited even where a marketing page describes broad possibilities. Extra packs reset rather than roll forward.
items.zh: 即使营销页描述能力广泛，自动化动作仍有额度；附加包按周期重置，不滚存。

pricing.billing_basis: Per workspace user with selected monthly/annual plan; workflow action capacity and recurring action packs separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Basic $24/user/month billed annually or $30 monthly; Basic Plus $34/$42. Business $60 monthly and Business Plus $84 monthly, annual pricing by quotation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Basic 按年付款每用户每月24美元或按月30美元；Basic Plus 为34／42美元。Business 按月60美元、Business Plus 84美元，其年价需询价。

faq.question_en: Is the 14-day trial a continuing free plan?
faq.question_zh: 14天试用是否等于持续免费套餐？
faq.answer_en: No. The pricing FAQ says a workspace is locked after trial until a plan is selected. Trial workflows also have a 500-action allowance.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。定价 FAQ 说明试用后需选择套餐，否则工作空间锁定；试用工作流另有500动作额度。

faq.question_en: Are waits and filters counted as ordinary actions?
faq.question_zh: 等待和筛选是否算普通计费动作？
faq.answer_en: The action guide excludes triggers and helper steps such as waits, splits, filters and stop from the action quota.
faq.answer_zh: 动作指南将触发器，以及等待、分流、筛选和停止等辅助步骤排除在动作额度之外。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Keep the email and the customer model connected
sections.en:
The Gmail page describes customer records, pipelines, personalized email and team tasks inside the inbox. The main setup path installs the NetHunt Chrome extension and connects the Gmail account. This is a useful starting point for a team already working from email, but channel access and CRM record access should be checked separately.

For an illustrative quotation discussion, identify the buying contact and deal, attach the next activity to the right owner, then inspect what a teammate can see. A message appearing in an inbox is not evidence that the CRM has the correct deal association. No extension, mailbox permission or sharing behavior was tested here.
sections.zh:
Gmail 页描述在收件箱内使用客户记录、管线、个性化邮件和团队任务。主要入门路径包括安装 NetHunt Chrome 扩展并连接 Gmail。对已经以邮件工作的团队，这是合适起点，但应分别核对渠道访问和 CRM 记录访问。

以假设的报价讨论为例，先确定采购联系人及交易，把下一活动交给正确负责人，再检查同事可见内容。邮件出现在收件箱，不证明 CRM 关联到正确交易。本文未测试扩展、邮箱权限或共享行为。

sections.title_en: Choose identifiers before merging or overwriting
sections.title_zh: 合并或覆盖前先选标识符
sections.en:
The duplicate guide describes import matching by a unique field and rules that can warn or block manual duplicate creation. A composite rule can combine fields. Choose a key appropriate to your real dataset: names alone can collide, shared email addresses exist, and company names can change. The editorial recommendation is to inspect ambiguous matches instead of treating a suggested field as universally unique.

For CSV updates, the help page says existing single-value fields are overwritten and new multivalue entries append. Test a record with existing values and a repeated import. Otherwise a file intended to enrich records could replace good information or accumulate unwanted entries. No matching or recovery operation was performed.
sections.zh:
重复指南说明导入时可按唯一字段匹配，并用规则对手动新增重复记录进行警告或阻止，也可组合多个字段。应按真实数据选择合适键：姓名可能相同、邮箱可能共用，公司名称也可能变化。编辑建议是核对模糊匹配，不能把建议字段视为任何数据中都唯一。

CSV 更新帮助页说明已有单值字段会被覆盖，多值新项会追加。应测试已有值记录及重复导入，否则用于丰富记录的文件可能替换正确信息，或累积不需要的条目。本文未执行匹配或恢复。

sections.title_en: Count successful actions in the designed flow
sections.title_zh: 按设计流程数成功动作
sections.en:
NetHunt defines a quota action as a successful execution of an Action-class step, such as creating/updating a record, creating a task or sending a message. Triggers and helpers such as waits, splits and filters are excluded. For a hypothetical flow that updates one field and creates one task for each of 500 qualifying leads, successful single execution implies 1,000 actions. It is not simply 500 because there are 500 leads.

The action guide lists 500 actions for a trial, 2,000 for Business and 5,000 for Business+. Confirm the actual workspace's counter and configuration before using this illustration for a budget. Repeated runs and additional action steps change the total; no workflow was executed or metered for this profile.
sections.zh:
NetHunt 将额度动作定义为 Action 类步骤的一次成功执行，例如新建／更新记录、创建任务或发送消息。触发器和等待、分流、筛选等辅助步骤不计入。假设500条符合条件线索各更新一个字段并创建一个任务，各成功执行一次时为1,000动作，不能因为线索500条就只算500。

动作指南列出试用500、Business 2,000、Business+ 5,000动作。预算前应核对实际工作空间计数器和配置；重复执行及增加动作会改变总量。本文未实际运行或计量工作流。

sections.title_en: Quota exhaustion can leave a triggered flow incomplete
sections.title_zh: 额度耗尽可能让已触发流程未完成
sections.en:
The action guide says triggers can still be recorded after the allowance is exhausted while execution fails at the next action. It describes warning emails near the limit and step history retaining received form fields even when a record could not be created. A recorded trigger therefore does not establish a completed lead handoff.

The page also contains transition/grace wording for some existing paid workspaces. Do not assume that exception applies to a new account. Inspect billing and execution history, preserve the source event and decide how to avoid duplicate work before recovery. Exact current grace eligibility and replay behavior remain unverified.
sections.zh:
动作指南说明，额度耗尽后仍可能记录触发事件，但执行在下个动作处失败；接近额度时有提醒邮件，即使无法创建记录，步骤历史仍可保存收到的表单字段。因此记录了触发，并不代表线索交接完成。

页面还保留针对部分既有付费工作空间的过渡／宽限说明，不能假定新账户也适用。恢复前应检查账单和执行历史，保留来源事件，并明确如何避免重复工作。当前准确宽限资格及重放行为仍未核实。

sections.title_en: Seat price, annual quotations and recurring action packs
sections.title_zh: 席位价、年度询价及持续动作包
sections.en:
The current cards list Basic at $24 per user/month billed yearly or $30 monthly, and Basic Plus at $34 or $42. Business shows $60 monthly and Business Plus $84 monthly, with their annual amounts requiring contact. Custom is an annual scoped option for teams of ten or more. Do not derive an annual Business quote by applying a generic discount sentence from the FAQ.

The 14-day trial is distinct from sustained free use; the FAQ says the workspace locks until a plan is selected afterward. Additional action packs are recurring monthly subscriptions: the guide gives 5,000 extra actions for $20 and says they reset on the workspace billing date without rolling over. Buying just before reset can provide only a short remaining window before the next charge. Confirm selected plan and action capacity together.
sections.zh:
当前卡片列出 Basic 按年付款每用户每月24美元或按月30美元，Basic Plus 为34或42美元。Business 按月60美元、Business Plus 84美元，两者年价均需联系。Custom 面向10用户及以上团队，按年度界定范围。不能用 FAQ 笼统折扣句直接推算 Business 年度报价。

14天试用与持续免费不同；FAQ 说明结束后需选择套餐，否则工作空间锁定。附加动作包属于每月续订订阅：指南举例5,000额外动作20美元，并说明按工作空间账单日重置、不滚存。重置前刚购买，可能只剩较短使用窗口就进入下次收费。应一起确认所选套餐和动作容量。

sections.title_en: A Gmail-centered CRM with broader channel requirements
sections.title_zh: 以 Gmail 为中心，也需核对更广渠道
sections.en:
NetHunt is a relevant candidate when a sales team wants record context close to Gmail and a manageable pipeline with optional automation. The present product extends beyond Gmail to multiple channels, but each required integration, data field and permission needs its own check. An integration logo is not proof of full two-way synchronization or unlimited sending.

Start with one live-like customer handoff and an exception before expanding. Self-hosting, component license, data residency, exact API quotas, regional account/payment access and UI languages were not established. No migration, mailbox, message, connector or workflow was executed, and no deliverability, reliability or customer-gain claim is adopted as a test result.
sections.zh:
销售团队需要让记录背景靠近 Gmail，并使用可管理的管线和可选自动化时，NetHunt 可列入候选。当前产品还扩展到多个渠道，但每项所需集成、字段和权限都应单独核对。集成 Logo 不证明完整双向同步或不限发送。

扩大范围前，先检查一条接近实际的客户交接和一个异常。自行托管、组件许可、数据驻留、准确 API 额度、地区账户／付款及界面语言尚未确认。本文未执行迁移、邮箱、消息、连接器或工作流，也不把送达率、可靠性或客户增长宣传作为测试结果。

seo.primary_intent: Evaluate NetHunt for a Gmail-centered sales process and its automation budget.

How does CSV updating treat existing fields?
